subject: calling setContentType outside of an R handler

messages.author: fe0b9140b8bdf3c1
messages.subject: calling setContentType outside of an R handler
parts:
Hello Rapache folks -

I'm attempting to make calls to the function setContentType outside
the file that RFileHandler directive point to.

This works:

## helloworld.R
main <- function() {
setContentType("text/html")
cat("<html><body><h1> Hello world </h1></body></html>")
}

But calling setContentType from a sourced file doesn't work:

## helloworld2.R
main <- function() {
sys.source("setContentType.R")
cat("<html><body><h1> Hello world </h1></body></html>")
}

## file setContentType.R
setContentType("text/html")

The error is: could not find function "setContentType"

----
What's the appropriate way to call setContentType, sendBin, and other
rapache-specific commands from files outside the RHandler?

Here's the relevant apache2.conf snippet:

<Location "/helloworld">
ROutputErrors
Options indexes FollowSymLinks
SetHandler r-handler
RFileHandler /var/www/R/helloworld.R::main
</Location>

Thanks!

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: calling setContentType outside of an R handler
parts:
You'll want to call sys.source with the argument envir=sys.frame(sys.nframe()).
Otherwise sys.source() evaluates the file in the base environment.

An alternative way would be calling source() with local=TRUE.

Jeff
